_about: Romesh Chunder Dutt's (1848-1909) condensations of the two Sanskrit epics into English verse: the Maha-bharata (1898, clean Gutenberg text) and the Ramayana (1899, raw Internet Archive OCR of an undated Google-scanned printing; Dutt died in 1909, so any printing is public domain). Dutt is the translator, recorded in each title. Google asks for non-commercial use of its scans; that is a request, not a legal restriction on a public-domain text (as with CCEL, rule 6).

dutt-mahabharata: Maha-bharata, the Epic of Ancient India, condensed into English verse by Romesh C. Dutt (1898)

dutt-ramayana: Ramayana, the Epic of Rama, Prince of India, condensed into English verse by Romesh C. Dutt (1899; undated printing)

_excluded.dutt-other-translators: Manmatha Nath Dutt's prose Ramayana (1891-94) and Ganguli's prose Mahabharata (PG 7864 and following, 15474-15477): other translators, not named by the relay
_excluded.dutt-dli: Digital Library of India copies of Dutt (in.ernet.dli.*) return 404 and are not used
